title: Derivative-consistent retention plus conductivity lookup
question: Can authoritative theta(h) and C(h)=dtheta/dh combined with frozen K(h) lookup preserve the analytical Richards convergence path while retaining meaningful constitutive and end-to-end speed benefit?
candidate: exact authoritative theta and C; adaptive lookup K for h<=-1 cm; exact authoritative near-saturation handling
rationale: F-AHL07 identified C approximation as the cause of the additional nonlinear iteration when theta was exact. K approximation affected only a very small endpoint discrepancy.

stage_1.advance_rule: candidate faster than full analytical evaluation for all tested materials

stage_2.required_convergence: same nonlinear iteration and backtracking counts as analytical
stage_2.performance_rule: median complete-solve CPU lower than analytical
